description: Keep one copy of repeated vector contours before cutting or engraving, even if their direction or closed-path start point differs. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.05 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Up to 64 paths, 256 vertices per path and 2,048 vertices total. Matches equal vertex counts and preserves the first copy.
name: prepare_duplicate_contours
